title: Big Strong Vehicles for Kids! Trains, Tractors and Cranes
intro: Hi, friends! I'm Bolt the little tow truck, and welcome to Tiny Truck Town!
Today we're meeting five big, strong machines that pull, lift and carry.
Can you count them with me? One, two, three, four, five!

lines: Here's our first one. Here's a clue: it rolls on tracks and says choo choo! Can you guess?
A train has an engine at the front.
The engine pulls all the cars along the tracks.
Can you chug your arms like train wheels? Choo choo!
Can you guess how many cars a long train can pull?
Train wheels roll on two strong metal rails.
Who's next? Here's a clue: it helps farmers in the fields! Can you guess?
A tractor pulls big tools that get the soil ready for planting.
Can you stomp like big tractor wheels? Stomp, stomp!
Can you guess why the wheels are so bumpy?
The bumps grip the ground, so the tractor doesn't slip in the mud.
Tractors help farmers grow the food we eat.
Who's next? Here's a clue: it has a super long arm and a hook! Can you guess?
A crane lifts things that are way too heavy for people.
Its long arm is called a boom.
Can you stretch up tall like a crane boom?
Can you guess? Can some cranes be taller than buildings?
Yes! Tower cranes can stand taller than the buildings they help build.
Cranes lift one piece at a time, slowly and carefully.
Who's next? Here's a clue: it carries heavy loads and tips them out! Can you guess?
Big dump trucks carry heavy loads of rock and dirt.
Strong pushers lift the bed up, called hydraulics.
Can you lift your arms up slowly, like a dump truck bed?
Can you guess where the rocks go?
They slide out the back, all in one big pile!
Let's say it together: DUMP TRUCK!
Some giant dump trucks are bigger than a house!
Who's last? Here's a clue: it has a ladder that goes way up high! Can you guess?
Fire trucks carry ladders and long hoses.
They carry enough water to fill lots of bathtubs!
Can you spray a pretend hose? Whoosh!
Can you guess how high a fire truck ladder can reach?
Some can reach as high as a ten-story building!
Let's say it together: FIRE TRUCK!
Firefighters practice a lot so they can help quickly.

recap: What big, strong machines! Let's remember.
A train can pull more than a hundred cars.
Tower cranes can be taller than buildings.
Dump trucks make a big pile.
And fire truck ladders reach super high!
outro: Which strong machine was your favorite? Be kind, and wave hello to the trucks you see.
Bye, friends! See you in Tiny Truck Town!
